title: SMART Trust demonstrator
description: The user journeys J1 to J4 of one cross-border family (birth-dose DVCs abroad, CHW triage read, clinic verification and schedule, family VHLs on one phone) as BPMN processes, personas and user scenarios, an Open Health Stack app that runs them with the Kotlin HCERT library, the Android test of that library, and the VaxLink workshop walkthrough of the same journeys (web/).

assets.title: SMART Trust demonstrator
assets.description: The four journeys, the library call each exercises, and the related repositories.

directories.description: The journeys' own skills (package journeys): CHW registration and referral, Immunization import, schedule evaluation, record assembly for a VHL, and holding VHLs on a shared phone. The HCERT and VHL skills are smart-trust-tools'.

One BPMN process per journey (J1, J2, J3, J4.0, J4.1) in the content concern group. Lanes are roles from scenarios/roles.json; tasks name skills. processes/content/decisions/ holds the DAK's decision tables (OMG DMN 1.3), each naming the BPMN tasks it serves and the requirements it applies; tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py renders them in the IG beside the data dictionary and indicators of dak/.

The roles that play the journeys' lanes, the personas and systems that play them (each naming the WHO SMART Trust, smart-trust-phw and IHE ITI VHL ActorDefinitions it instantiates), and the user stories. Every person is fictional. scenarios/user-scenarios/ holds one user scenario per journey (J1, J2, J3, J4.0, J4.1) and the group journey J4, in the harness's user-scenario kind, from which tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py writes the User scenarios section of docs/journeys.md; the harness's check:journey-refs checks their references in CI.
Owner directives: the journeys and their two countries, consuming the library from a pinned commit, and being a full downstream.
The open issues of this project, one bean each under beans/defs/; tagged upstream when the fix belongs in another repository.
repo-checks: the standard-library checks CI runs (actions pinned, JSON, memory front matter, journey consistency); archimate: the DPI-H RA overlay spec and its build.
The Kotlin HCERT library at a pinned smart-trust-tools commit: the lock (commit and jar sha256) and the script that builds and checks the jars.

The demonstrator as an ArchiMate overlay on the DPI-H Reference Architecture: smart-ra's model 0.3.0-draft.1, unchanged, plus the journeys J1 to J4.1 (use cases), the people assigned to them and the Thai and Lao systems that serve them, each system a specialization of the RA building block it instantiates. Built by tools/archimate/build.py from tools/archimate/overlay.py and smart-ra at the commit in tools/archimate/smart-ra.lock.json; cat-harness's archimate subgraph draws every view as SVG.

This instance's glossary (folio-glossary/v1, SKOS): architecture.glossary.json holds a concept for every element the ArchiMate overlay draws (the person roles, the system and external actors and their parts, the journeys, and each country's instance of the RA building blocks), generated by tools/ig-gen/ig_gen.py from scenarios/ and processes/; each model element names its concept by skosConcept.

The VaxLink walkthrough (moved from litlfred/vaxlink on 2026-11-05): the journeys J1 to J4.1 told as people and moments for a workshop, with the technical and policy layers under each moment and the device screens S1 to S8. A React and Vite app; it imports the actors from scenarios/actors/, the BPMN drawings from processes/content/ and the moment pictures from docs/images/ at build time, and shows the site's own ArchiMate drawings, so it is built from the same commit as the journeys. scripts/publish.sh places the build in the published site; scripts/ig-examples.mjs copies the FHIR examples from SUSHI's output and checks the copy.

The walkthrough's content as TypeScript: the moments and how each person lives them (journeyData.ts), the building blocks and each moment's technical layer (techData.ts), the workshop's policy layer (policyData.ts), the device screens and payloads (storylineData.ts). ig/ is the IG examples as SUSHI writes them, never edited by hand (CI ig-sushi runs ig-examples.mjs --check). No cat-harness kind describes the journey map, the per-moment use of a building block or the workshop layer yet: bean KG-01.

The published walkthrough, on the gh-pages branch inside the demonstrator's site: vaxlink/ for main, STAGING/<branch>/vaxlink/ for any other branch. Built by npm run build in web/ (never committed) and placed by web/scripts/publish.sh after the site's own publish; index.config.json keeps vaxlink/ in a root publish.

The journeys J1 to J4.1 as user scenarios (journey maps), J4 as the group journey over J4.0 and J4.1, each with its scene, illustrations, FHIR changes and ArchiMate views. The building-block catalogue their steps use is in archimate/building-blocks/.

What each person sees on their own device at a journey step: the VaxLink screens S1 to S8 as device-screen nodes (the harness's kind), drawn by the journeys viewer as device mocks in the workshop's Device Demo and linked both ways with the walkthrough. Every person is fictional.
The DPI-H policy-maker track taught from the journeys.
The record-trust ladder the journeys' steps name.
The building-block catalogue the journeys steps use.
The artefact index, built at publish from the IG AST.
